categories.zh: 技能 / 施法 / 战斗演示

entries.name: Kenney Game Assets
entries.en: Thousands of consistent 2D sprites, UI, 3D models and sound packs; great for prototypes and game jams.
entries.zh: 上千套风格统一的 2D 精灵、UI、3D 模型和音效包，适合做原型和 Game Jam。

entries.name: Quaternius
entries.en: Low-poly 3D packs (characters, nature, buildings, weapons) in FBX/OBJ/glTF; free packs are CC0.
entries.zh: 低多边形 3D 素材包（角色、自然、建筑、武器），FBX/OBJ/glTF 格式，免费包为 CC0。

entries.name: OpenGameArt.org
entries.license: Per asset (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / GPL / OGA-BY)
entries.en: Community library of 2D, 3D, music and SFX; each asset page states its license, so check before use.
entries.zh: 社区共享的 2D、3D、音乐和音效库；每个素材页都标明许可证，使用前逐个确认。
entries.license_zh: 按素材单独授权（CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / GPL / OGA-BY）

entries.name: KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets
entries.license: Per model (mostly CC0 / CC-BY-4.0; a few under custom terms, see REUSE.toml)
entries.en: Reference glTF models for testing loaders, PBR materials and engine import pipelines.
entries.zh: 官方 glTF 参考模型，适合测试加载器、PBR 材质和引擎导入流程。
entries.license_zh: 按模型单独授权（多为 CC0 / CC-BY-4.0，少数为自定义条款，见 REUSE.toml）

entries.name: Poly Haven
entries.en: High-quality PBR textures, HDRIs and photoscanned models; ideal for realistic scenes and lighting.
entries.zh: 高质量 PBR 贴图、HDRI 环境光和扫描模型，适合写实场景和打光。

entries.name: ambientCG
entries.en: Large CC0 library of PBR materials, HDRIs and models with multiple resolutions.
entries.zh: 大量 CC0 PBR 材质、HDRI 和模型，提供多种分辨率。

entries.name: Freesound
entries.en: Huge community sound library; filter by license (CC0 or CC-BY for commercial games) and credit when required.
entries.zh: 超大社区音效库；按许可证筛选（商用游戏选 CC0 或 CC-BY），需要署名时照做。
entries.license_zh: 按音效单独授权（CC0 / CC-BY-4.0 / CC-BY-NC-4.0）

entries.name: Sonniss #GameAudioGDC Bundles
entries.license: Royalty-free (Sonniss license: commercial use, no attribution required)
entries.en: Yearly free bundles of professional SFX, royalty-free for commercial games.
entries.zh: 每年免费放出的专业音效合集，商用游戏免版税。
entries.license_zh: 免版税（Sonniss 许可：可商用，无需署名）

entries.name: chr15m/jsfxr
entries.en: Browser-based retro sound effect generator (sfxr port) for jumps, coins, hits and lasers.
entries.zh: 浏览器里的复古音效生成器（sfxr 移植），一键出跳跃、金币、受击、激光音。

entries.name: Alchemist0823/three.quarks
entries.en: General-purpose particle system / VFX engine for three.js, with a visual editor.
entries.zh: three.js 通用粒子 / 特效引擎，带可视化编辑器。

entries.name: creativelifeform/three-nebula
entries.en: WebGL particle engine for three.js; JSON-defined emitters for fire, smoke and magic effects.
entries.zh: three.js 的 WebGL 粒子引擎，用 JSON 定义发射器，做火焰、烟雾、魔法特效。

entries.name: effekseer/Effekseer
entries.en: Particle effect editor and runtime with plugins for Unity, Unreal, Godot and web.
entries.zh: 粒子特效编辑器和运行时，支持 Unity、Unreal、Godot 和 Web。

entries.name: Kenney Particle Pack
entries.en: 80 particle sprites (smoke, fire, sparks, magic) to drop into any particle system.
entries.zh: 80 张粒子贴图（烟、火、火花、魔法），可直接放进任意粒子系统。

entries.name: achrefelouafi/LinearAbiltyCastingThreeJS
entries.en: three.js demo of line-cast and far-cast abilities (aim arrow, target circle, beam, lance, meteor) with HUD.
entries.zh: three.js 技能施法演示：直线施法和远程落点（瞄准箭头、目标圈、光束、冰矛、陨石），带 HUD。

entries.name: jammyfu/open-game-skills
entries.en: Agent skills for building games with coding agents: game feel, combat, camera and engine adapters, with runnable examples.
entries.zh: 给编程 Agent 用的游戏开发 skill：手感、战斗、镜头、引擎适配，附可运行示例。

entries.name: Quaternius Universal Animation Library
entries.en: 120+ humanoid animations (locomotion, combat, emotes) on a universal rig, ready to retarget in Unity, Unreal and Godot.
entries.zh: 120+ 人形动画（移动、战斗、表情动作），通用骨骼，可在 Unity、Unreal、Godot 里重定向。

entries.name: Kenney Animated Characters
entries.en: Rigged, animated low-poly characters for quick 3D prototypes.
entries.zh: 带骨骼和动画的低多边形角色，适合快速做 3D 原型。

entries.name: Blender
entries.en: Free 3D suite for modeling, rigging, animation and baking game assets; your output is yours.
entries.zh: 免费 3D 全家桶：建模、绑骨、动画、烘焙；做出来的作品归你。

entries.name: RodZill4/material-maker
entries.en: Node-based procedural texture and material authoring tool built on Godot.
entries.zh: 基于 Godot 的节点式程序化贴图 / 材质制作工具。

entries.name: Orama-Interactive/Pixelorama
entries.en: Pixel art editor for sprites, tiles and frame animation; runs on desktop and web.
entries.zh: 像素画编辑器，画精灵、图块和逐帧动画；桌面和网页都能用。

entries.name: mapeditor/tiled
entries.en: Flexible tile map / level editor; exports TMX/JSON used by most 2D engines.
entries.zh: 灵活的瓦片地图 / 关卡编辑器，导出的 TMX/JSON 被大多数 2D 引擎支持。

entries.name: deepnight/ldtk
entries.en: Modern, lightweight 2D level editor with auto-layer tiling and typed entity fields.
entries.zh: 现代轻量 2D 关卡编辑器，支持自动图层铺块和带类型的实体字段。

entries.name: audacity/audacity
entries.en: Audio editor for trimming, layering and cleaning up game sound effects.
entries.zh: 音频编辑器，剪切、叠加、降噪游戏音效。

entries.name: LMMS/lmms
entries.en: Free music production software (sequencer, synths, sampler) for game soundtracks and stingers.
entries.zh: 免费编曲软件（音序器、合成器、采样器），做游戏配乐和短提示音。

entries.name: godotengine/godot-demo-projects
entries.en: Official Godot demo and template projects (2D, 3D, physics, UI) to learn from or start with.
entries.zh: Godot 官方示例和模板项目（2D、3D、物理、UI），可以照着学或直接起步。
